_comment: Applied by scripts/build_content_proposal.py on top of the three section reviews. Reasons are shown in the consolidated proposal.

appearance-theme-file-editor-screen.why: Owner decision: the Theme File Editor is core functionality and relevant to block themes (under Tools). Also linked from wp-admin theme-editor.php.

tools-network-screen.target: Short user-level page; detailed multisite setup links to developer.wordpress.org
tools-network-screen.why: Linked from wp-admin network.php, so the slug must keep serving a page.

faq-troubleshooting.why: Linked from core's fatal error handler (the 'critical error' notice). Becomes the user-level troubleshooting page instead of moving off-site.

troubleshoot-common-problems.why: Superseded: faq-troubleshooting is rewritten into this page so the core-linked slug survives.

pages-add-new-screen.why: Linked from wp-admin edit-form-advanced.php; a redirect keeps the help tab working while the classic edit-screen content goes away.
